root_cause.text: `net/sched/cls_u32.c` in the `u32_classify()` path passed potentially negative header offsets to `skb_header_pointer()`, which failed to fully validate them and could lead to out-of-bounds reads from the skb data.
root_cause.evidence: The patch removes a manual `skb_headroom(skb) + toff > INT_MAX` check and replaces multiple `skb_header_pointer()` calls with `skb_header_pointer_careful()`, while the commit message explicitly says `skb_header_pointer() does not fully validate negative @offset values` and cites a KASAN `slab-out-of-bounds in u32_classify()` at `net/sched/cls_u32.c:221`.
